diagnosis: Previous Claude Code session ran inside the VS Code integrated terminal; an unwrapped python3 started by root or a Haiku subagent (blend-lab / kaggle-cohort / vast-cohort were active) ran in the VS Code scope outside wnn-campaign.slice, reached 15.8 GB anon and caused global OOM; the Claude Code process/session died, stopping all subagents. Campaign-slice systemd fit h230-strong-parent-seed9-muon-local-v1 survived with zero OOM in its cgroup.
impact: Lost: kaggle-cohort and vast-cohort builders (no durable files), blend-lab analysis (no outputs), session cron loop. Not lost: seed9 fit, marimo server unit, committed work.
corrective_rules: Every subagent python/CLI command runs via scripts/limited inside wnn-campaign.slice with WNN_MEM_MAX <= 4e9 unless root admits more
Never read whole parquet files; use row groups / column projection
Long work runs as systemd units, never as session-bound background shells
Root chains critical-path stages in durable systemd units so a session crash does not stall compute
